notes.title: Achievement Patch
notes.notes:
The recent update had a bug that caused achievements to not activate. The problem has been corrected and they should be working normally for everyone now. Apologies and please don't hesitate to reach out to us if you run into any issues!

-Vanis

notes.title: Project Cappuccino - v1.25.3 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This may come as a surprise but we’ve released an optimization patch for Project Cappuccino! Originally, we developed this as our first project with little experience, but have gained considerable knowledge since its release and used an opportunity we had to make some fixes to the game. Unfortunately, some things like adding more save slots would require major reworks since we didn’t know better at the time and we risk breaking saves. (So that stuff will need to wait for an eventual remaster!)

However, there’s been massive optimization fixes done and the game is smoother to play now. If you run into any bugs, please don’t hesitate to let us know and we’ll do our best to solve them.

[b]Here’s what’s changed.[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized load times between large scenes such as the Cafe Lobby. Players should see around 20-30% faster loading between scenes.
[*] Optimized Compression of Some Sprites: This should also contribute to loading times and the game’s file size.
[*] Cleaned up unnecessary code
[*] Added new SFX to secret Sophie route
[*] Grammar Fixes
[*] Embedded Discord Link in Game: Come join us for news on all things Tentakero.
[/list]

Thank you for playing and be sure to wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1887580/Project_Cappuccino_2_The_Succubus_Throne/]Project Cappuccino 2![/url]
-Vanis & Doku

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.25.2 - Achievement & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Some of you may have noticed that there have been some updates pushed out to Project Cappuccino recently. We’ve been dealing with some backend bugs and making some minor adjustments. Here’s what’s changed.

[list]
[*] [b]Resolved an Issue with Steam Achievements being broken due to an appID mismatch.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed Censorship Mistake:[/b] There was a mixup in the version intended for Japan and we accidentally left in a censor in the cut in camera of the Inn Room encounter.
[*] [b]Fixed Room 3 Colette Bug:[/b] Vag Toys were cropping improperly due to a sprite mask.
[*] [b]Fixed Request Bubble Bug:[/b] Tracked down a rare bug that was being triggered by request bubbles activating endlessly. It is our suspicion that this bug is what was causing the game to crash at times on certain Mac computers. We’re not 100% sure if it’s solved the mac crashing but we’ll continue to monitor the situation.
[*] [b]Modified Request Bubble Frequency:[/b] Max spawn time for a request bubble has been reduced but bubbles now become less frequent if you’re already using some of the girls requested toys.
[/list]

We're hard at work on a new title and will likely be posting about it here when we have more info to share!

Thanks for playing,
Vanis & Doku

notes.title: The Lucretia Update is Here!
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/231010975497715712/670334485023293450/LucretiaUpdate_Header_Capsule.png[/img]

Lucretia can now be unlocked by purchasing all toys in story mode. If you already have an existing save file with everything purchased, simply head into the shop and it will trigger the special unlock dialogue! From there, she’ll become accessible in Free Play mode permanently. (Or until you delete all your save data.)

[b]Along with this, we’ve also fixed a few bugs:[/b]
-Fixed Text Error in Chapter 2: Following Colette into the woods had a line that made it sound as if Sophie was there too.
-Fixed Colette Work Assignment Bug: Colette had a wire crossed that was causing the stress meter to overflow during work assignment. Issue was only happening when assigning specific amounts of work.
-Fixed Mira Undressing System Bug: Removing her accessories was not properly disabling other buttons and would allow spam clicking of other clothing parts.
-Fixed Cerise Request Bubble Bug: The Bunny was counting as the Clothing pins whenever she requested that particular toy.
-Fixed Mira Request Bubble Bug: Some of Mira’s bubbles were not disappearing when the requested toy was used.

We hope you guys enjoy Lucretia and thank you for playing Project Cappuccino!
-Vanis & Dokucchi

notes.title: Free Update Coming to Project Cappuccino!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam and all who inhabit it! We want to start off our first announcement by thanking you for playing Project Cappuccino! Our dev team is composed of two people and we really bust our asses working on this game. Seeing people enjoying it is incredible and we can’t thank you enough!

[b]We are aware of some bugs and are working on them![/b]
Some of our players have informed us of some issues that they've run into. The biggest one being a Colette bug that causes her route to supersede others if her standing is low enough. (Under -15 to -20 or so)

The second bug is more of a minor oversight! There’s an achievement that requires finding 3 gnomes hidden in the game’s backgrounds but we accidentally added a 4th gnome at some point in development and forgot about it completely! He’s sitting on the bottom left shelf of Sweet Seductions and isn’t clickable, so there are 3 others hidden out there.

We’re working to get these bugs patched ASAP and will roll out a patch as soon as it’s been taken care of. Thank you for your patience in that regard!

[b]Upcoming Free Lucretia Patch to all owners of the game[/b]
Those of you that have been following us for a while are probably aware of this, but we’ve got some news for new players!

Late into development, we managed to hit a stretch goal of adding Lucretia to Free Play mode. She will be coming to all owners of the game as a Free Update in the next couple of months. We aim to have her available in all 3 rooms, including the Inn Room’s undressing system.

Along with this, there is also some sprite artwork improvements that will be made. The girls expressions will have alternate poses to go with them, that way it’s not just the faces that change.

We hope you guys are as excited for the update as we are, and thank you for the successful launch!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EJgb7UbXYAABflX?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]

We'll keep you guys informed if there are any change in plans!
-Vanis & Dokucchi
